notes: Every FAISS vector row must have exactly one entry.
faiss_id must match the ID returned by the serialized FAISS index, not an incidental JSON row number.
The release compiler checksum-protects this file alongside the index.

bounds_enu_m and image_uri are required by build_training_map_pairs.sh. They bind a cloud-training positive to a real, release-controlled map crop; the Pi retrieval runtime only needs tile_id, faiss_id, center_enu_m, and scale_m_per_px.
